name: Bethia Horton

relationships.evidence: Akerly: Henry Tuthill m. before 1690 'Bethia Horton (Capt. Jonathan, Barnabas)'; Horton Genealogy lists Bethia among Capt. Jonathan & Bethia (Wells) Horton's children

bioAdditions: Wife of Henry Tuthill 'the Justice'. A family record printed in the Horton Genealogy (S2) gives her death on 16 Mar 1744 'in the 73d year of her age' and Henry's on 4 Jan 1750 aged 84; Akerly gives her birth as about 1674. As a daughter of Bethia Wells she is John's 1st cousin 10 times removed through William Wells, and the great-grandmother of First Lady Anna Symmes Harrison.

conflicts.foundValue: c. 1674 (Akerly) vs c. 1671 (age at death in family record)

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Parentage in Akerly and Horton Genealogy.
